Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: VP needs to join tomorrow morning

Hi Soojin / Kimberly,

Apologies for the late ping — our VP of Product (Samir) had a travel change and asked if he can join the platform walkthrough tomorrow morning instead of the afternoon slot we discussed. He only has a hard window between 9:00–10:00am PT before heading to the airport.

Two asks: can Redwood either (a) move our session into that 9–10am window or (b) compress to a 30-minute executive brief inside that period? If neither works, Samir asked whether we can swap to the following morning.

We realize this is short notice — we can be flexible on attendees and scope. Let me know what works and what you need from our side (slides, a short agenda, or a dial-in).

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Brightworks

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and no worries about the short notice.

We can accommodate this but need to confirm two internal things: Marcus (product engineering) wants to ensure the demo covers the new low-latency routing improvements (takes ~10–15 minutes to explain), and Kimberly will verify whether our CTO (requested by your team) can join as well. If CTO joins, we should plan for 45 minutes; if it's VP-only, we can compress to ~30 minutes with a tight agenda.

Options from our side:
- Option A: Move to 9:15–9:45am PT (30m) — executive brief + Q&A; Marcus will join for the architecture 10-min quick hit.
- Option B: Move to 9:00–9:45am PT (45m) — CTO or senior eng coverage if they can join.
- Option C: Keep tomorrow afternoon but move to next morning (Tue 9:00–10:00am) if travel makes morning impossible for us.

If you can confirm whether Samir prefers a compressed, 30-minute executive snapshot or a fuller 45-minute walkthrough (and whether the CTO needs to be on the call), we'll lock down invites. We can send a condensed agenda immediately.

Best,
